name: MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund
source: MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund audited annual financial statements for the 10 months ended 31 December 2025 (Ernst and Young Nigeria, published on the NGX filing library), statement of financial position, NGN thousands; and the Fund's unaudited Q2 2026 investor report as at 30 June 2026, NGN thousands.

periodBasis.Q2 2026: as at 30 June 2026, unaudited investor report
periodBasis.FY2025: as at 31 December 2025, audited. The Fund commenced operations on 17 March 2025, so this is its first annual period and no earlier comparative exists.

rows.label: Cash & Equivalents
rows.note: Cash and cash equivalents, printed as such on both statements.

rows.label: Total Liabilities
rows.note: Accrued expenses plus other payables plus distribution payable. The interim report prints these in parentheses as a presentation choice; stored positive.

rows.label: Total Equity
rows.note: Equity contributions from unit holders plus retained earnings.
